The main takeaway from our work is that
the “power to weigh” ratio should be used only for the comparison of actuators which are of similar type and not for comparison between different types of actuators.

the weight of the actuator itself is not the main parameter to compare between different actuators, but rather the weight of the whole actuator and transmission system is the main factor in such comparison.
